data.name: Marisol
data.gender_notes: Marisol is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Marisol is derived from the Spanish words 'Mar' meaning sea and 'Sol' meaning sun. It is a beautiful name for a little girl, evoking images of the sun, sea and the Virgin Mary. It is a name rich in meaning and symbolism, reflecting the beauty and power of nature. The name Marisol carries the meaning “Little Mary of the Sea” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Marisol usually hope their child will grow to embody little mary of the sea and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Marisol is a name of deep spiritual significance. It is derived from the Spanish words 'Mar' meaning sea and 'Sol' meaning sun. In the Christian faith, the sea represents the vastness of God's love and the sun represents the light of God's grace. Marisol is a name that reminds us of the power and beauty of God's creation and the spiritual journey of life.
data.etymology: Marisol belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Little Mary of the Sea.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Marisol total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
